question: Normally, there is a ________ day interval between spring tides and neap tides.
solution:
The correct answer is __**seven.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **There is a seven-day interval between the spring tides and neap tides.**
 
• Tides are the rise and fall of sea levels caused by the combined effects
